name: FV_ATTR_SUPPL_RULE_FILTERS
description: This table stores the federal attribute supplemental rule filter records.

columns.name: SUPPL_RULE_FILTER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the federal attribute supplemental rule filter.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number of the federal attribute supplemental rule filter.

columns.name: SUPPL_RULE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the federal attribute supplemental rule line.

columns.name: SUPPL_RULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the federal attribute supplemental rule header.

columns.name: SEGMENT_CODE
columns.description: Accounting segment code from the associated chart of accounts attached to the ledger.

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Operator code of the operator used. It is based on the ORA_FV_REPORT_CODE_OPERATOR  lookup. Valid values are  Between, Equal To, Not Equal To.

columns.name: SEGMENT_LOW
columns.description: Low range value of the accounting segment.

columns.name: SEGMENT_HIGH
columns.description: High range value of the accounting segment.

columns.name: SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the accounting segment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
